outcome: epidemiological data (age, gender, level of surgery)
radiographic parameters (lumbar lordosis, anterior and posterior disc space height)
intraoperative and postoperative complications (bleeding, venous lesions)
cohort: 70 patients who underwent spinal surgery using the Anterior Lumbar Interbody Fusion (ALIF) technique between February 2019 and January 2021.
finding: Patients undergoing ALIF showed significant improvement in radiological parameters including increased lumbar lordosis and anterior/posterior vertebral disc height, with a 9.8% complication rate and short hospital stays.
